function.arguments: {"observation": "The contract specifies the population as 'All customers in the sales data' (900 rows), but we excluded 108 rows with age = -1, reducing the population to 792. The reviewer is correct that this changes the denominator and thus conflicts with the contract.", "implication": "We cannot exclude the -1 rows without violating the contract. The estimand is the mean age of all customers in the data, even if some have missing age values. However, using -1 as a numeric value in the mean would be misleading, as it is not a real age. We must either include it (which biases the mean downward) or clarify that the mean is computed only on available data. But the contract requires all customers. Therefore, we must include -1, or reframe the estimand. Since the documentation explicitly says -1 means 'the customer did not supply an age', it is not a valid age value. Including it violates the meaning of the data. This is a conflict between the contract and data validity. We must resolve it by questioning the contract's premise."}
function.name: note_finding
